title: Promotional Art
body:
## Merl's Workshop

Promotional Art ports the textures found in Merl's Workshop texture atlas file (workshopTextureAtlas.png) from the official Minecraft website.

![workshopTextureAtlas.png](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1b7066e3ce6f4c59f521e6e7a0713bae2283fd81.png)

## Animated textures too


![Fire](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/66adfa47b1d255d59218000e9ad188255673e06d.gif)
![Smoker](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/21cf178f7d1a08285d81208240fa29f42fd22faf.gif)
![Sculk catalyst](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4620d5d2f8e86c92e919f55ea8ba7ebe00aaf4b5.gif)
![Kelp](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8db3f7930c968f2f05ee41c706a9ca9b719622f9.gif)

And more...

## Make your minecraft look like the official Trailers
Combine [Bare Bones](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bare-bones) entity textures and block colormap with Promotional Art block textures in order to get a more accurate Trailer Look!!


![Promotional Art and Bare Bones](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6ec99d3257e1ee6505ee3988bb8dcde422cd0461_0.webp)
